name: 🎹Piano Tower
desc:
🎹 Welcome to Piano Tower!

🎵 Step across giant piano keys and climb your way to the top of the tower!
⚡ Each step plays a note, but be careful, some keys might troll you!
😈 Trollers can mess with your rhythm, so stay focused and keep your balance!
🏆 Reach the top before the others and become the Piano Master!

👉 Like 👍 the game & join the group for special rewards!
